summary: A notification bell icon button wrapped in a count badge, shown in the four badge colors.
use: Telling apart badge meaning on a counter: brand, success, warning and error.
spec: `<Flex gap="4" align="center" wrap>` wraps four badges
Each is a `<Badge count={5}` around `<IconButton aria-label="Notifications">` with a `<Bell size={20} />`
